set.body: Add lisa_onesample(), lisa_twosample(), and lisa_glm() as thin wrappers that call null_one_sample(), null_two_sample(), and null_glm(), then lisa(). Do not duplicate model or resampling code inside LISA wrappers. Document GLM/Freedman-Lane as the recommended route for nuisance-adjusted or unbalanced group analyses.
set.title: LISA: raw-image wrappers via shared null factories
